coach.headline: A gritty top that fought for every single hold
coach.summary: You powered through some awkward body positions and locked in a solid V4 send. The next step to make this feel effortless is keeping your feet engaged so your upper body does not have to carry the whole load.

strengths.title: Rock-solid anchor foot
strengths.detail: Your right foot glued to the blue hold low on the wall for over seven seconds, giving you a steady base to sort out your upper body.

strengths.title: Tenacious grip
strengths.detail: When moves got tense or positions got stretched, your hands never gave up their real estate on the wall.

focus.title: Keep the left foot working
focus.detail: Around 14.4 seconds while moving past the middle section, your left leg cut loose and spent over five seconds dangling in space. Spot a solid smear or toe hook on the left volume immediately to take the weight off your arms.

focus.title: Commit on the high reaches
focus.detail: At 11.2 seconds, your right hand reached up toward the blue hold in the upper half before hesitating and retreating back to the right hold. Trust your initial read and drive through your hips on the first go.

focus.title: Streamline the finish match
focus.detail: After tagging the finish hold at 21.2 seconds, you spent five seconds adjusting feet and hanging on before matching hands. Get your high right foot set on the right volume before lunging for the top so you can match instantly.

drills.name: Sticky Feet
drills.how: Climb warm-up boulders where you must silently place each foot on target without any sliding, tapping, or re-adjusting.

drills.name: Hover Hands
drills.how: Hover your hand for two full seconds over your target hold before gripping it to ensure your base is stable.

coach.beta: Move smoothly off the start, keep your left toe flagged firmly on the blue volume while reaching through the middle holds, and step your right foot high onto the right hold before matching the top.
coach.next_goal: Send this blue problem again with zero foot cuts and finish in under 20 seconds.
